text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data travelling between the user and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor login, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Developers must also validate all input to stop harmful code from entering the system. Common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting are serious threats, but they can be avoided with careful coding and regular testing. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and their personal information.
